text: Shut the door. Slowly. The hinge talks.
You found the Nest, so somebody talked, or you're cleverer than you look. Either way. I buy what the guild won't pay proper for, and I sell what the guild pretends doesn't exist.

options.text: Does the guild know about this place?

text: Back again. Nobody followed you? Good. Show me what the dead gave you.
Anything that came out of a gate. Corks, hemp, wax, the hard bits off the big ones. The trophies, most of all. A hangman's hood, a crowned skull of moss. There's collectors.
I'll pay you more than the stuff's worth to you. Less than it's worth to them. That's the whole of my trade.
The guild knows. The guild drinks here on its days off. The guild's receptionist bought a ring off me last spring and told her mother it was from a suitor.
Keep your voice down about it, that's all I ask. Things are only illegal when they're loud.
A barrel on the carters' road that ate two men. A dead knight walking the drove road in his cage. A stag out by the rot that's more fungus than meat. The guild's posted all of them.
Bring me what's left of them after. The knight's shackles fetch a fair price. Don't ask me who's buying.
